nodes.description: Public token name string, set to "myCryptoWallet".
Public token symbol string, set to "MCW".
Public decimals value, set to 10.
Public total token supply; mutated by constructor and burn.
Public address of the contract deployer; receives initial supply and is debited by burn.
Public mapping of token balances per address; mutated by transfer and burn.
Deployer-only constructor: sets supply, founder = msg.sender, and grants full supply to founder.
View function returning the current supply value.
View function returning balances[tokenOwner] for an arbitrary address.
Public transfer of tokens from msg.sender to a target address with only a require-based balance check.
Public burn function reducing both founder balance and total supply by _value; no sender authorization checks.
Caller-controlled address used as founder in the constructor and as the debited account in transfer.
Unchecked credit of tokens to the recipient balance; can overflow supply accounting.
Unchecked debit of tokens from the caller balance; can underflow.
Unchecked decrement of total supply inside burn; can underflow.
Unchecked decrement of the founder balance inside burn; can underflow.
Destination address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer used in both arithmetic updates.
Burn amount parameter used in both burn arithmetic updates.
Address parameter of balanceOf used as mapping key.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the supply state variable.
founder is assigned directly from msg.sender, so the deployer controls this state variable.
Constructor initializes balances[founder] with the whole supply.
totalSupply returns the supply state variable.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
balanceOf uses the tokenOwner parameter as mapping key.
transfer reads the caller-controlled msg.sender balance in its require check and debit.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transfer receives the tokens amount as a parameter.
transfer receives the destination address as a parameter.
transfer executes the unchecked addition balances[to] += tokens.
transfer executes the unchecked subtraction balances[msg.sender] -= tokens.
tokens parameter is added to the recipient balance without overflow protection.
to parameter indexes the mapping entry updated by the unchecked addition.
msg.sender balance is debited by an unchecked subtraction.
tokens parameter is subtracted from the caller balance without underflow protection.
burn reads the balances mapping to check the founder balance.
burn executes the unchecked subtraction supply -= _value.
burn executes the unchecked subtraction balances[founder] -= _value.
_value parameter is subtracted from supply without underflow protection.
_value parameter is subtracted from the founder balance without underflow protection.
supply state variable is the target of the unchecked decrement.
founder state variable indexes the balance entry debited by burn.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter to is only used as the mapping key for the unchecked credit balances[to] += tokens, so it can be folded into that unsafe operation node.
Parameter tokens is the value applied in the unchecked balance arithmetic of transfer and can be merged into the credit operation.
Parameter _value is the amount subtracted from the founder balance inside burn and can be folded into that unsafe operation node.
Parameter tokenOwner is only used as the lookup key of balanceOf and can be merged into that function node.
